# Source-backed CUE fixture

The original Docker Spotify `.github/workflows/environment.cue` is retained with
its MIT notice. Its complete 566 physical bytes have SHA256
`2c99e3bd0d827b92df2c36cc4cda8477c6f95d1e43cc7775abfa1fd9ebb49185`.
The finite field/containment witnesses describe written lexical source only;
imported schemas, constraint evaluation and whole-language semantics are not
inferred from this fixture.
